research_claim: A bounded, auditable four-component policy manager learns conservative resource routing that balances immediate response quality, interaction-and-grounding risk, and generator/context cost under one fixed resource and generation stack.
not_claimed: perfect memory selection or perfect generator grounding
transport to arbitrary future resource schemas without retraining

stage_0_objective_hard_gate.behavior: deterministic deny only when the backend can prove invalidity

stage_1_worth_opening.target: repeated-seed expected net component value after valid V4 Step2 execution
stage_1_worth_opening.output: four probabilities plus uncertainty and in-support flags

joint_selector.rule: project independently requested bits into a boundary-, risk-, and budget-feasible action; lower expected net value bits are dropped first

stage_2_typed_resource_adapter.MP_PREFERENCE: compile the active preference into a response-format constraint; measure it only when its trigger move is present
stage_2_typed_resource_adapter.MP_PROFILE: compile a nonredundant stable fact or practical constraint into a silent planning constraint; never expose internal profile labels
stage_2_typed_resource_adapter.MS_SESSION: compile the exact prior fact, distinction, or question as prior-session evidence; answer a factual recall request directly or ask one tentative continuity check
stage_2_typed_resource_adapter.ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME: compile past action plus observed outcome as one optional present action; preserve past attribution and never promise transfer
stage_2_typed_resource_adapter.RS_ATOMIC_MOVE: compile exactly one allowed support move with card-specific when-to-use and when-not-to-use constraints

generator.input: visible dialogue plus already compiled response constraints/evidence

post_generation_guard.on_failure: one deterministic context-only safe response; never a second unconstrained LLM fallback

expected_unsupported: complex multi-entity temporal inference from raw prose
step1_capability_boundary.maximum_reached_definition: one frozen transparent primary and one frozen BGE challenger have been fit on the complete planned FIT set and consumed once on untouched confirmation; no post-confirmation model, feature, threshold, or sample changes

step2_confirmation.development_evidence: the consumed V3 32-item T1 may guide the architectural class but is not a V4 promotion set
machine_gates: exact resource ID and typed adapter binding
zero unsupported history in deterministic fallback

effect_data_after_step2_pass.quality: pairwise material adoption preference aggregated across frozen seeds
effect_data_after_step2_pass.training_target: predeclared net-value label or soft probability derived after valid execution

external_relation.ESConv: tests RS and memory-unavailable/off with the same bank and runtime
external_relation.EvoEmo: tests MP_PROFILE, MS_SESSION, ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME and in-support coverage with per-user isolation and the same compiler
external_relation.internal_controlled: tests MP_PREFERENCE, hard negatives, all 16 actions, and joint conflicts not covered externally
